grounds: confine.py:534 `f"the probe's {', '.join(unran)} reported no exit status: the check did not run"`; the mutant drops the first constant 'the probe's ' only (diff verified with mutant_view), leaving '<names> reported no exit status: the check did not run'. The other message that begins 'the probe's ' (confine.py:427, the left_on_host problem) is matched by equality (test_v21_confine.py:538-540), never by prefix, so dropping this lead-in cannot merge the two. In the operator's text the refusal reads '...is not provided: write_kernel, setsid reported no exit status: the check did not run; ...', which still says which checks and why.
